newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Glengarry lifts Coolgardie gold resource.
newsitem.headline: Glengarry lifts Coolgardie gold resource.

text.p: Glengarry Resources NL on Tuesday lifted the resource estimate for its Gunga West deposit to 70,000 ounces of gold from 1.03 million tonnes of ore grading 2.1 grams per tonne (g/t) at a 0.5 g/t cut-off grade.
The Gunga West deposit is within the company's 100 percent owned Coolgardie project, located eight kilometres northeast of Coolgardie in Western Australia.
Glengarry said at a 1.0 g/t cut off grade the resource measured 60,000 ounces of gold from 620,000 tonnes of ore at 3.0 g/t.

"This new resource estimate represents a 300 percent increase on the preliminary estimate of 23,700 ounces (410,000 tonnes at 1.8 g/t) reported to the Australian Stock Exchange on April 4, 1996," the company said in a statement.
The company said the resource remained open at depth.
At 12.00 p.m (0200 GMT), Glengarry shares were steady at 10.5 cents.
